title: Verified worker outcome in Command Centre
goal: Expose the latest deterministically accepted worker result in Command Centre without changing acceptance or execution authority.
laws: Surface consumes the proven worker acceptance gate; it does not infer acceptance itself.
Show mission, job, builder, verifier, status and changed-file count.
Missing or invalid evidence renders no accepted worker outcome.
No worker invocation or product mutation occurs.
Authority remains false on the OS surface.
No stale result may be displayed as current acceptance.
